title: Barnes Akathisia Rating Scale (draft v1, awaiting owner review)
description: Clinician-rated four-item instrument for drug-induced akathisia: observation plus subjective experience. Supports assessment and change tracking; does not by itself establish medication causation.

steps: Observe the patient seated for at least 2 minutes while engaged in neutral conversation.
Observe the patient standing for at least 2 minutes while engaged in neutral conversation.
Note relevant movements seen at other times (walking into the room, routine activity).
After observation, ask directly about inner restlessness, the urge to move, and associated distress.
administration.look_for: Leg or foot shuffling, stamping, swinging a leg while seated, rocking from foot to foot, walking in place, repeated standing or pacing, inability to remain seated or standing. Separate characteristic movements from occasional nonspecific fidgeting.
interview_prompts_not_scored: Do you feel restless inside or feel that you need to move?
Is the feeling mainly in your legs, or elsewhere in your body?
Do you find it difficult to keep your legs still?
Do you have a strong urge to walk or pace?
Is the restlessness worse when you must stand or sit still?
How much of the time do you experience the urge to move?
How distressing is the restlessness: not at all, mildly, moderately, or severely?
Does it interfere with sitting, lying down, sleeping, work, or other activities?
administration.prompts_note: Interview prompts assist administration and are not additional scored items.

items.prompt: Objective restlessness: characteristic restless movements during the observation period (leg/foot shuffling, stamping, swinging a leg while seated, rocking foot to foot, walking in place). 0 normal/occasional fidgeting; 1 present less than half the period; 2 present at least half the period; 3 virtually constant or cannot remain seated/standing without walking or pacing.

Subjective awareness of restlessness: inner restlessness and urge to move. 0 none; 1 nonspecific inner restlessness; 2 difficulty keeping legs still / desire to move legs / worse when required to stand still; 3 intense compulsion to move most of the time or strong desire to walk or pace most of the time.
Distress related to restlessness. 0 none; 1 mild; 2 moderate; 3 severe.

Global clinical assessment of the overall syndrome (observation plus subjective report plus clinical judgment). 0 Absent (no subjective awareness; characteristic movements without subjective restlessness are pseudoakathisia); 1 Questionable (nonspecific tension with fidgeting); 2 Mild (leg/inner restlessness especially when required to stand still; distress minimal or absent); 3 Moderate (subjective restlessness plus characteristic movements, distressing); 4 Marked (compelling desire to walk/pace with obvious distress, can remain seated at least 5 minutes); 5 Severe (strong urge to pace most of the time, cannot sit/lie more than a few minutes, constant restlessness, intense distress, insomnia).

completeness.rule: All 4 items required when akathisia status is present. Absent and not_assessed require no questionnaire completion. Missing required items suppress calculated results to null (never zero) unless a reviewed source explicitly defines a missing-data rule; no such rule is defined here.

scoring.record_separately: Record all four item scores separately: objective /3, awareness /3, distress /3, global /5.
scoring.component_total: First three items may be summed as a descriptive component total 0-9 for tracking change; the original author regards the global item as the principal overall severity measure. No summed severity rule is invented beyond this descriptive total.
scoring.global_threshold_source_backed: Global 2 or greater indicates akathisia present per the BARS threshold: 2 mild, 3 moderate, 4 marked, 5 severe. Global 2 may rest on a characteristic subjective report even with only nonspecific fidgeting visible.
scoring.pseudoakathisia: Objective movements without subjective restlessness are pseudoakathisia: reassess history, differential, and course rather than assuming acute medication-induced akathisia.
scoring.causation: The BARS threshold does not establish medication causation; apply timing and exclusion criteria separately.

urgent.note: No BARS-specific emergency threshold is defined in the source. Urgent clinical concerns ride separately from questionnaire completion and never wait for it.

source.note: Item wording and anchors follow akathisia-criteria.md §BARS verbatim in meaning; global range corrected to 0-5 per the source note.

assumptions: Four items with ranges 0-3/0-3/0-3/0-5 are the complete BARS per the supplied criteria.
Global is the principal severity measure; the 0-9 component total is descriptive only.

independent_examples.name: all_zero_absent
independent_examples.expected: complete; component_total 0; global 0 Absent; no akathisia per threshold.

independent_examples.name: moderate_present
independent_examples.expected: complete; component_total 6; global 3 Moderate; akathisia present.

independent_examples.name: one_missing_suppresses
independent_examples.expected: partial; missing [bars_global]; component_total null; global null (never zero).

independent_examples.name: pseudoakathisia
independent_examples.expected: complete; global 0 Absent with pseudoakathisia note; threshold not met; reassess rather than assume akathisia.

severity_mapping.reviewed_severity: bars_global 0-5 with source labels (0 Absent, 1 Questionable, 2 Mild, 3 Moderate, 4 Marked, 5 Severe). Present requires global >= 2 plus complete questionnaire and reviewed severity; absent/not_assessed carry null severity.
severity_mapping.no_summed_rule: No invented summed-severity bands from the 0-9 component total.

network_mappings.F2_akathisia: Effect presence plus reviewed global severity plus history context (onset timing, medication timeline, exclusions). BARS items are measurement context only; medication causation uses timing/exclusion criteria separately.

mapping_gaps: F2 gate wording (substantial/persistent restlessness) and deterministic-rule versus estimated-table semantics require owner review before package use (S34).
Motor restlessness versus unreviewed differential assumptions stay distinct; no new mandatory scale beyond this approved content.
